topics.title: zizmor
topics.question: Does the repository check its GitHub workflows with zizmor?
topics.detection: We look for zizmor in the repository's workflows and action files (its GitHub Action or a command) and in its pre-commit hooks. Comments are ignored, so a note like "zizmor: ignore" does not count. A pre-commit hook counts as running in CI when a workflow runs pre-commit or the pre-commit config has a "ci" section, which sets up pre-commit.ci.

meanings.partial: zizmor is set up, but nothing shows that CI runs it.
meanings.missing: The repository has workflows and no sign of zizmor.
meanings.n/a: The repository has no GitHub workflows to check.

topics.title: SECURITY.md
topics.question: Does the repository say how to report a vulnerability?
topics.detection: We look for a SECURITY.md where GitHub does: in the repository's .github folder, root and docs folder, then in the organization's .github repository. A repository needs one if it ships a package or a container image. When the repository and its organization both have one, we compare the emails they list.

meanings.done: It has a SECURITY.md, its own or its organization's.
meanings.partial: Its own SECURITY.md lists other emails than its organization's, so reports may go to the wrong place.
meanings.missing: It ships a package or an image and has no SECURITY.md, not even its organization's.
meanings.n/a: It ships no package or image.

topics.title: PyPI attestations
topics.question: Do the repository's PyPI releases have attestations?
topics.detection: We ask PyPI whether every file of the latest release of each PyPI package has an attestation. An attestation is made in CI with trusted publishing and names the repository and workflow that published the file. Packages whose latest release is older than 2024-10-29, when attestations became the default, are left out. PyPI's API shows trusted publishing only through attestations, so a release without them may still have used it.

meanings.done: The latest release of each of its PyPI packages released since 2024-10-29 has attestations.
meanings.partial: Some of its PyPI packages have attestations on their latest release, and some don't.
meanings.missing: None of its PyPI packages has attestations on its latest release.
meanings.n/a: It has no PyPI package released since 2024-10-29.

topics.title: npm trusted publishing
topics.question: Does the repository publish its npm packages with trusted publishing?
topics.detection: We ask npm whether the latest version of each npm package was published with trusted publishing: from CI, with a short-lived token instead of a stored one. Packages whose latest version is older than 2025-07-31, when npm launched it, are left out.

meanings.done: The latest version of each of its npm packages released since 2025-07-31 used trusted publishing.
meanings.partial: Some of its npm packages used trusted publishing for their latest version, and some didn't.
meanings.missing: None of its npm packages used trusted publishing for its latest version.
meanings.n/a: It has no npm package released since 2025-07-31.
